info.name: TestMu AI SmartUI API Documentation Autoheal Command Logs Get Screenshot Status API
Fetch build status by buildId / buildName

params.name: projectToken
params.description: To validate the project in which you want to map your uploaded screenshots

params.name: buildId
params.description: You can pass the id of speicifc build if you need to map multiple screenshots of different tests to one build. (Optional)

params.name: buildName
params.description: You can pass the name of specific build if you need to map multiple screenshots of different tests to one build. (Optional)

items.docs: This API fetches the status of all screenshots which are uploaded to smartui using either build id or build name. **Note:** When both `buildId` and `buildName` are provided in the request, `buildId` will be given priority over `buildName`.
